name: GeoBrowser (hosted)
postCreateCommand: npm ci && npm run build && (sudo chown root:root node_modules/electron/dist/chrome-sandbox && sudo chmod 4755 node_modules/electron/dist/chrome-sandbox) || true
postAttachCommand: nohup ./scripts/serve.sh > /tmp/geobrowser.log 2>&1 & echo 'GeoBrowser starting — open the forwarded port 7860'
